principle: The graph is the readable, labelled, ordered, previewed process. Lettered boxes in a fixed order, a note at the top of each, a preview after each stage.

boxes_in_order.name: READ FIRST + CHANGE REPORT
boxes_in_order.purpose: status note and the version's change report; read before anything else

boxes_in_order.name: INPUT
boxes_in_order.purpose: hero-eye plates, served names kept exactly, Cineon log->linear stated on the Read node

boxes_in_order.name: PAINT INPUTS
boxes_in_order.purpose: generated paint and hand-painted matte where a lead Gen exists, aligned to the plate

boxes_in_order.name: FILL + MASK / LEAD ASSETS
boxes_in_order.purpose: fill and comp matte at proxy; geo matte as parent for tracker and solve

boxes_in_order.name: TRACK + SOLVE
boxes_in_order.purpose: tracker and object solve; superseded chains stay muted, not deleted

boxes_in_order.name: CARRY + SOLVE HEALTH
boxes_in_order.purpose: carry the fill by the solve; stick check against current and new solve

boxes_in_order.name: COMP WRITE
boxes_in_order.purpose: the comp: plate*(1-m) + fill*m, in scene-linear; OFF until told to go

boxes_in_order.name: REVIEW OUTPUT
boxes_in_order.purpose: mp4 and numbered proxy sequence into 06_REVIEW, new versions only

boxes_in_order.name: STEREO CONVERSION
boxes_in_order.purpose: second eye = hero-eye layers moved by measured disparity; grain per eye

every_box: a MarkdownNote at the top naming the box and what it does
stock nodes first, custom nodes only for what ComfyUI lacks
no silent behaviour: a graph never auto-corrects or guesses
every_revision: a new _v### file; never overwrite a last known good
status term from the contract set
node_pack: ComfyUI-BH-ShotPipe-v##; the graph's BH##_ prefix says which version it was built with. In this repo the packs are the shared/nodes submodule (comfy-node-packs); docs/NODE-PACKS.md

colour.cdl: one global CDL per shot, same in both eyes
colour.matte: one comp matte, white = fill, black = plate
